question: Against matched direct controls, does compact claim-link batching retain quality and reduce input and completion time on the two new fixture shapes?

source_capability.use: header-first quality capability and descriptive comparison; not a fresh Series 007 call

call_budget.reset_credits: do not consume without explicit operator approval

capability_thresholds.quality: every direct and batch critique has every expected claim status, expected verdict, same-claim finding links, and zero unlinked findings
capability_thresholds.order_check: both candidates pass once in each batch position across the source capability and fresh reversed batch

interpretation_limits: One direct call per candidate and one batch per order establish only a matched capability result, not a stable median.
The source header-first batch predates this plan and is reported separately from the fresh reversed batch.
Do not increase batch size, combine provider tokenizers, or generalize to mutable or dependent work.
stop_rules: Run exactly one scheduled cell per invocation and never retry automatically.
Commit every attempted cell before starting another.
Stop after any excluded run, structured quality failure, provider drift, or current-window usage at or above 60 percent.
Do not edit candidates, expected statuses, prompt hashes, or thresholds after the first live call.
